about_the_game:
Your New Life Awaits

Welcome to the Flatlands, a land of charm and wonder! Your little shop is about to become the beating heart of the village. Stock your shelves with mystical wares and fantastical things, from fresh home-grown produce to masterfully crafted artisanal goods, making sure all of the townsfolk have everything they need – whilst also making a profit, of course! Build, decorate, and expand your shop to your heart’s content, meet eccentric travelers and locals, and uncover hidden tales along the way!

Run Your Dream Shop

Stock your shop with a wide variety of products, from freshly farmed fruit and vegetables, to aromatic alchemical elixirs, to shining suits of armor. Keep up with the demands of your customers by varying your goods, and adjust your pricing to line your pockets in an ever-changing economy.

From the Ground Up

Start with a modest little shopfront offering a handful of wares, and grow into a bustling market that serves the whole town and beyond. Customize your shop layout and design, placing walls, windows, and doors wherever inspiration strikes. Profit, expand, rinse and repeat!

Fine-tune your store’s décor to your heart’s content with a free form furnishing placement system and hundreds of decorations & customizations to choose from. The more enchanting your store, the more customers will come flocking, and the more silver will fall on your counter!

Do It Yourself

Don’t want to rely on traders for your wares? Become an artisan! Craft your own stock at various workstations, including a tailor’s desk, an alchemy station, and even a forge. Grow your skills and become a master of your craft – the more advanced, the higher the price!

Manage your very own farm to stock your shelves with homegrown fruit and vegetables. Plant seeds, nurture them, and harvest fresh crops to feed the townsfolk.

A Dynamic World

Every villager has their own tale to tell. Get to know them, forge relationships, and uncover their quirks and secrets. Explore the town and discover different vendors. Who knows, you might even make some friends along the way!

With each new season comes new challenges, new products, and new customers. Keep a watchful eye on world events and changes through your map, adjust your strategy, and make sure your shop thrives no matter what the year brings.

It’s Just Business, Baby

Things becoming a little too much to handle on your own? Hire employees to help out around the store, so you can have some well-deserved rest and relaxation. Train them to sharpen their skills, keep them motivated with fair wages, or show them the door if they start slacking off - it’s all part of running a thriving business!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: i5 6300U
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 770
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Ready to take on the management of a fantasy shop? Faire Trade allows you to do just that! From farming, to crafting, to selling, to hiring, to expanding, to pricing, to decorating to….. Well, the world's your oyster! Stay curious, adapt, and let your blossoming shop shine!
